There is a private copy-forward hash batch of 500.

get_cached_vector_blob(...):
  Look up a unit-vector blob by workspace, dataset, version, profile_hash, and text_hash.
  Give back None on miss or dimension mismatch.

put_cached_vector(...):
  Upsert a unit vector into the rebuildable search cache.

copy_forward_cached_vectors(db, workspace_id, dataset_id, version_id, profile_hash,
  dimensions, text_hashes):
  Copy cached vectors into this version from any other version of the same
  workspace and dataset id with the same profile_hash and dimensions.
  Only the given text_hashes are considered.
  Deduplicate the hash list.
  If the list is empty, return.
  Insert in fixed-size batches with INSERT OR IGNORE so an existing row for this
  version, or two donor versions of the same hash, do not fail.
  Stamp created_at on the copied rows.
  Commit once after the batches.
  Do not call the embedding provider.
